slots.description: The alert's main content or title
Slot in an icon to override the default one
slots.name: icon

events.name: open
events.description: Fired when the alert becomes visible. Detail: `{ active }` — the new visibility state. Note this event name is unprefixed, unlike the rest of the library.

events.name: close
events.description: Fired when the alert is dismissed. Detail: `{ active }` — the new visibility state. Note this event name is unprefixed, unlike the rest of the library.

variant.description:
Variants
- **default** renders a alert that represents an informative state
- **success** renders a alert that represents a success state
- **warning** renders a alert that represents a warning state
- **danger** renders a alert that represents an danger state

isActive.description:
isActive boolean
- If true, the alert displays on the page
- If false, the alert is hidden from the page

autoClose.description:
Auto close?
- Set whether you want the alert to auto close. Adjust the autoCloseDelay if you want longer than 3 seconds

autoCloseDelay.description:
Auto close delay
1. Number of seconds to close the alert when autoClose is enabled
2. Default amount is 3

isDismissible.description:
Dismissible?
- If true, displays a close button with close functionality on the alert
